notes: Mortgage and housing updates from primary public sources.

items.title: Price-drop rate ticks up to record September rate amid strong buyer’s market
items.title_zh: Redfin：9 月降价挂牌占比创同期纪录，买方市场仍强
items.summary: Redfin’s MLS-data analysis found that 21.1% of U.S. active listings had an asking-price cut in the four weeks ending September 20, up from 19.8% a year earlier and the highest rate for this time of year in its records since 2022. This measures listing price cuts, not closed-sale prices or individual seller outcomes.
items.summary_zh: Redfin 对 MLS 数据的分析显示，截至 9 月 20 日的四周内，美国活跃挂牌中有 21.1% 下调要价，高于一年前的 19.8%，且为其自 2022 年有记录以来的同期最高水平。这衡量的是挂牌降价，并非成交价或任何个别卖家的结果。

items.title: U.S. house prices rose 0.3% in July, FHFA says
items.title_zh: FHFA：美国 7 月房价环比上涨 0.3%
items.summary: FHFA’s seasonally adjusted monthly House Price Index reported U.S. house prices rose 0.3% in July from June and 2.6% from July 2025 to July 2026. The index is a repeat-sales measure based on single-family mortgage transactions purchased or securitized by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, not a measure of every home sale.
items.summary_zh: FHFA 的季调月度房价指数显示，美国房价 7 月较 6 月上涨 0.3%，较 2025 年 7 月上涨 2.6%。该指数以房利美和房地美购买或证券化的独户住宅重复交易为基础，并不衡量所有房屋成交。

items.title: The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate was 7.03%
items.title_zh: 30 年固定房贷全国平均利率为 7.03%
items.summary: Freddie Mac's PMMS reported a 7.03% average, up from 6.95% the week before. The 15-year fixed average was 6.42%.
items.summary_zh: Freddie Mac 的 PMMS 显示，30 年固定房贷平均利率为 7.03%，高于前一周的 6.95%；15 年固定房贷平均利率为 6.42%。

items.title: Las Vegas and Florida are America’s hottest destinations for relocating house hunters
items.title_zh: Redfin：拉斯维加斯与佛州是跨都会区找房者最热门目的地
items.summary: Redfin’s Q2 migration analysis found Las Vegas had the largest net inflow of Redfin.com home searchers (9,581), while Los Angeles had the largest net outflow (-28,652); Florida led states with a 38,922 net inflow. These figures measure Redfin.com users’ search behavior—not closed sales—and may include vacation or investment-property searches.
items.summary_zh: Redfin 对 2026 年第二季度跨都会区找房行为的分析显示，拉斯维加斯的净流入最多（9,581 名 Redfin.com 找房者），洛杉矶的净流出最多（-28,652 名）；佛州以 38,922 名净流入居各州首位。这些数字衡量的是网站用户的搜索行为，并非已成交房屋，且可能包含度假屋或投资房搜索。

items.title: August new home sales ran at a 684,000 annual rate
items.title_zh: 美国 8 月新建独栋住宅销售季调年率为 68.4 万套
items.summary: The Census Bureau and HUD reported that August sales of new single-family houses were at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 684,000, up 6.4% from July and down 2.0% from August 2025. The estimated inventory was 483,000 new homes, equal to an 8.5-month supply at the current sales rate.
items.summary_zh: 美国人口普查局与 HUD 报告称，8 月新建独栋住宅销售季调年率为 68.4 万套，较 7 月上升 6.4%，较 2025 年 8 月下降 2.0%。待售新房估计为 48.3 万套，按当前销售速度计算相当于 8.5 个月供应量。

items.title: Mortgage applications decrease in latest MBA weekly survey
items.title_zh: MBA：最新周度调查显示抵押贷款申请下降
items.summary: MBA reported that total mortgage applications fell 1.5% on a seasonally adjusted basis for the week ending September 18. The refinance index fell 3% and the purchase index fell 1%. Its average 30-year conforming contract rate rose to 7.12% from 6.97%; this is a survey average for specified loans, not an individual lender quote.
items.summary_zh: MBA 表示，截至 9 月 18 日当周的抵押贷款申请总量经季调后下降 1.5%，再融资申请下降 3%，购房申请下降 1%。其调查中的 30 年期合规贷款平均合同利率由 6.97% 升至 7.12%；这是特定贷款条件下的调查平均值，并非个人可获得的贷款报价。

items.title: Redfin reports U.S. home prices rose 0.25% from a month earlier in August
items.title_zh: Redfin：美国 8 月房价环比上涨 0.25%
items.summary: Redfin’s Home Price Index reported seasonally adjusted U.S. single-family home prices rose 0.25% in August from July and 3.7% from a year earlier. The index uses a repeat-sales method, and its August reading covers the three months ending August 31.
items.summary_zh: Redfin 房价指数显示，经季调后美国独栋住宅价格在 8 月环比上涨 0.25%、同比上涨 3.7%。该指数采用重复交易法计算，8 月读数覆盖截至 8 月 31 日的三个月。

items.title: FHA seeks feedback on proposed changes to single-family minimum property requirements
items.title_zh: FHA 就单户住房最低物业要求拟议调整征求意见
items.summary: FHA posted proposed updates to its single-family Minimum Property Requirements, saying it would reorganize and refine standards to reflect current industry practices. Feedback is due November 6, 2026. The proposal is not official policy and cannot be used for FHA-insured mortgages unless finalized.
items.summary_zh: FHA 发布单户住房最低物业要求的拟议更新，称将重组和完善相关标准以贴合当前行业实践，意见征集截止至 2026 年 11 月 6 日。该草案尚非正式政策，在最终定稿前不能用于 FHA 承保贷款。
